# Tom the Chiropractor

> Chiropractic clinic in central Loughborough, Leicestershire, UK. GCC-registered chiropractor (MChiro, Welsh Institute of Chiropractic), fully insured. Treats neck, back, shoulder, joint and muscle pain, headaches and sciatica. Same chiropractor at every appointment, with evening (until 7pm) and Saturday appointments. Initial consultation £70 (60 minutes), follow-up treatment £45.

## Key facts

- Practitioner: Tom, MChiro, Welsh Institute of Chiropractic (graduated 2021), registered with the General Chiropractic Council (GCC), fully insured
- Location: The Work Lounge, 1 Beehive Lane, Loughborough, Leicestershire, LE11 2WN
- Booking: online booking widget at https://www.tomthechiropractor.co.uk/#book, or WhatsApp +44 7871 283457
- Pricing: initial consultation £70, follow-up treatment £45
- Hours: evening appointments until 7pm on weekdays, Saturday mornings
